open_points.subject: pending confirmation identity
open_points.text: “at most one pending confirmation — its one-time value” and “The confirmation id of an action the owner confirms in it is minted per confirmation”
open_points.question: Is the pending confirmation’s one-time value the confirmation id, minted when the confirmation step is shown, or is it a separate value from a confirmation id minted only when the owner confirms?
options: They are the same identifier, minted when the step is shown
They are distinct: a pending one-time value is minted when shown and a confirmation id when accepted
The confirmation id is minted when shown but recorded only if accepted
open_points.default_guess: Treat them as the same identifier, minted when the confirmation step is shown.

open_points.subject: last-request instant
open_points.text: “changed by the owner's requests (State 2 A13, A16; owner, 2026-10-31): the instant of its last request”
open_points.question: Which requests move the last-request instant: every authenticated owner-interface request, only product actions, only successful requests, or some other declared set?
options: Every authenticated request, including reads and refused requests
Every owner product action, including reads, whether accepted or refused
Only accepted owner product actions
Only accepted state-changing actions
open_points.default_guess: Move it on every authenticated owner-interface request, including reads and refused requests.

open_points.subject: pending confirmation lifecycle
open_points.text: “made when a confirmation step is shown, replaced by the next one shown and cleared when used”
open_points.question: What counts as the pending confirmation being “used,” and what happens to it when the submitted action is refused, the owner cancels, or the confirmation page is merely revisited?
options: Any submission consumes it, accepted or refused; cancellation and revisit do not
Only an accepted action consumes it; a refused attempt leaves it pending
Submission or explicit cancellation consumes it; refusal leaves it pending
Showing the step again always replaces it, even for the same action
open_points.default_guess: Consume it on any submission, accepted or refused; leave it pending on abandonment or cancellation unless another confirmation is shown.

open_points.subject: confirmation binding facts
open_points.text: “the action, its target, the revision or access version and the inputs it is bound to”
open_points.question: For each confirming product action, which target, version and input facts are actually stored in the pending confirmation, including what “access version” applies to when none of the currently confirmed primary actions changes session access?
options: Declare a distinct binding fact set for each of archive, project erasure, import and audit-entry erasure
Store one generic action, target, optional version and complete input value set
Store only a commitment or digest over the action inputs
Access-changing actions also require confirmation, despite the Primary actions not saying so
open_points.default_guess: Declare per-action binding facts and store a non-personal commitment over inputs; do not add confirmation to access-changing actions.

open_points.subject: uploaded import file action
open_points.text: “at most one uploaded import file, replaced by the next upload and dropped when the import is accepted”
open_points.question: Is uploading or replacing the file a distinct owner product action that changes OwnerSession, or is it an internal step of the existing “import projects with their identity” action?
options: A distinct upload action changes the session; the later confirmed import reads that upload
One import action includes upload, confirmation and acceptance
Showing the import confirmation performs the upload or replacement
open_points.default_guess: Treat upload as a distinct owner-interface action and the confirmed import as the action that reads the pending upload.

open_points.subject: uploaded import file lifecycle
open_points.text: “replaced by the next upload and dropped when the import is accepted. Everything in it ends with the session.”
open_points.question: After a confirmed import is refused, or after the owner abandons or cancels the import, does the uploaded file remain available for retry or get dropped?
options: It remains until a successful import, replacement or session end
Every confirmed import attempt drops it, accepted or refused
Cancellation drops it; refusal retains it
Both cancellation and refusal drop it
open_points.default_guess: Retain it after refusal or abandonment until successful import, replacement or session end.

open_points.subject: confirmation-bound import inputs
open_points.text: “the import file uploaded in an owner session (M11), which holds such values” is `personal_data`, while “the owner session, but for its uploaded import file” is `business_confidential`, and M11 stores “the inputs it is bound to”
open_points.question: When an import confirmation is bound to inputs containing personal values, does the pending confirmation store those values and therefore carry `personal_data`, or only a non-personal reference or digest so that every non-file OwnerSession fact remains `business_confidential`?
options: Store only a digest or reference; the uploaded file is the sole `personal_data` OwnerSession fact
Store the actual inputs and classify those pending-confirmation facts as `personal_data` too
Exclude import inputs from the pending confirmation binding
open_points.default_guess: Store only a digest or reference to the uploaded file and other inputs, leaving the file as the sole `personal_data` OwnerSession fact.
